record.title: Weak Interaction
record.name: WeakInteraction
record.content: Weak interaction (Weak Force) is one of the 4 know interaction in physics. It's only stronger than gravitational force, but the range over which weak interaction occurs is very small (10^-18 m) thus making it's effect even harder to detect. Weak interaction involves all of the left-handed leptons and quarks. Main carriers of weak interaction are W and Z bosons. Weak interaction is the only interaction that viloates parity and changes flavours. This interaction is responsible for beta decay process and thus is part of a lot of naturally occuring radiation processes.
